question: How much of the glyph-adjudication instrument ceiling (0.9402 with gold boxes) survives production-legal wiring: detector boxes, gold-free triggers, blind forced choice inside the station?

challenger_v5.identity: omp_toolbelt5 variant (v3 agent surface + deterministic adjudication post-pass), prompt transcribe/zh/toolbelt3

amendments.finding: Post-run audit of run artifacts established that the operator swapped the second-reader and adjudicator identities from gemini-3.6-flash to gemini-3.5-flash in the working tree while this experiment was executing. The smoke ran with adjudicator gemini-3.6-flash (smoke output telemetry); the full 24-page run executed with BOTH the second reader (geometry.json second_reader.model) and the adjudicator (output telemetry adjudication.model) on gemini-3.5-flash. This also explains the challenger fingerprint rotation: 29f8831a... was rendered at 18:54 from the 3.6 tree; the executed full-run challenger fingerprint is f07b5898... and the executed baseline fingerprint is 159c5b40....
amendments.consequences: The adopted headline numbers (judged 0.9740, sequence 0.8594, 19/24 wins) are evidence for the gemini-3.5-flash configuration, which matches the current tree and the 2026-07-29 production read rollback note (3.5-flash reads better). The smoke and full runs are not identity-comparable to each other. Records referencing fingerprint 29f8831a as executed should defer to this amendment.
amendments.pricing_note: gemini-3.5-flash is priced by the genai-prices catalog; gemini-3.6-flash prices via the hardcoded fallback. No cost blackhole in either configuration.

runs.smoke: toolbelt5-mthv2-smoke4-v1 (4/4 sealed, telemetry live, 3/4 strict recall wins, 2.7605 USD)

judged_answer_recovery.judge_retry_note: two gateway-failed judgments were purged and re-judged to completion; zero failed rows in the final artifact

deterministic_sequence_recall.ordering_class_note: Three pages are ordering-limited this run: GL-1054-1-12 (0.2705), GL-1054-1-13 (0.3848), and a session-lottery instance mth1000-006 (sequence 0.6059 but BAG recall 0.9706, judged 0.997, output length equal to baseline). The class is block-order versus annotation order, orthogonal to glyph adjudication; mth1000 corpus mean is dragged under baseline solely by that one page.

gates.full_recall: FAIL on the mean half (0.8594 < declared 0.88); the wins half passes (19/24 >= 16). The declared mean assumed ordering-limited pages could be lifted; they cannot be by glyph work, and a third page joined the class by session lottery.
gates.adjudication_health: pass (max page patch fraction 0.12 vs 0.40 limit, zero skips)

decision: adopted as development champion; declared mean gate recorded as failed
decision_detail: v5 dominates on the operator's chosen lens - judged answer recovery 0.9740 with 4 perfect and 1 partial versus 2 and 4 - and wins the deterministic pairs 19/24 with pages at 0.95+ jumping 2 to 10. On the 21 pages the pass can affect, sequence recall moves 0.8925 to 0.9221, and the production-legal pass retains most of the instrument's gold-box gains at 0.07 USD per page. The declared 0.88 full-run mean was missed for a reason the evidence isolates precisely: a reading-order class that single-character adjudication cannot and should not touch. Recording the gate failure as failed rather than reinterpreting it; adopting v5 as the development champion on preponderance; production untouched. The binding residue is now ORDERING, not character identity: the next instrument is reading-order alignment (detector-order versus annotation-order reconciliation), plus the known missing-small-text class.
next_permitted_action: Design the reading-order experiment against the three ordering-class pages; do not propose or promote from this evidence.
